bodyDesign: 收臂蓄力→拳/掌/肘击→回到待机

actualReferenceOverride.prop: folded paper map held in his anatomical LEFT hand (viewer RIGHT), glasses on cap, hiking backpack and beige explorer clothing
actualReferenceOverride.attack: Keep the paper map in his LEFT hand clearly visible. Point or strike outward with the EMPTY RIGHT hand; do not lose or change the map.
actualReferenceOverride.skill: Keep the map in LEFT hand, gesture to a route on it with RIGHT index finger, decisive explorer command.
